description:
Read Botrotation's public service overview before evaluating a rental.

        Returns capabilities, dated research counts, selection/evidence limits and
        payments.methods, the full supported asset/network list with invoice identifiers.
        Use subscription_plans for price/slots, evaluate_bots for current bot metrics,
        and agent_onboarding for registration and purchase instructions. No arguments,
        authentication or payment required; this read does not create an invoice or account.
        Upstream failure returns an MCP tool error, not an empty offer.
name: discover_botrotation

asset_name.description: Issuer/representation name; BNB-chain stablecoins are Binance-Peg assets.
asset_name.title: Asset Name

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID; the same asset on another chain is a different route.
chain_id.title: Chain Id

gas_asset.description: Network gas coin, paid separately from the subscription amount.
gas_asset.title: Gas Asset

payment_method.description: Exact identifier to pass when requesting an invoice.
payment_method.title: Payment Method

recipient.description: Revenue address; use the issued invoice's complete transfer instructions.
recipient.title: Recipient

token_contract.description: Pinned ERC-20 contract; null for a native coin.
token_contract.title: Token Contract

enabled.description: Whether new subscription payment collection is enabled.
enabled.title: Enabled

methods.description: Complete currently enabled asset/network allowlist; legacy top-level asset fields describe only the default.
methods.title: Methods

price_usdc.description: Decimal USDC reference price; other assets use an expiring invoice quote.
price_usdc.title: Price Usdc

outputSchema.description: Service overview; relative API paths resolve against https://api.botrotation.com.

evaluation.description: Public current-dashboard access and freshness guidance; use evaluate_bots for rows.
evaluation.title: Evaluation

history.description: Public permanent-offer history coverage and access; use bot_history for records.
history.title: History

onboarding.description: Registration/delegation endpoints; use agent_onboarding for the ordered workflow.
onboarding.title: Onboarding

research.description: Dated factory record counts, definitions, selection methodology and evidence limitations.
research.title: Research

service_boundary.description: Customer authority, capital custody and execution responsibilities.
service_boundary.title: Service Boundary

outputSchema.title: DiscoveryResult
